findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Especialistas em Instalação e Manutenção de Ar C" → 3 lines (10 words, 64px); "Mais do que um serviço — uma parceria de confian" → 4 lines (10 words, 44.8px)
findings.fix:

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "⭐ Garantia de 6 Meses | Atendimento Rápido" (pill) above "Especialistas em Instalação e Manutenção"; "Nossos Resultados" (pill) above "Números que comprovam nossa excelência"; "O que fazemos" (pill) above "Serviços Completos em Climatização"; "Exclusivo" above "Pintura de Equipamento"; "NOSSOS VÍDEOS" (pill) above "Canal Renostter"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 15 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Nossos Resultados", "O que fazemos", "Mais Solicitado", "Exclusivo").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🏢 💼 🧹 📐 🔧 🔍 ⚙ ✨ 💨 📋
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 11 gradient fill(s): a.btn-primary → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255, 107, 0), rgb(229, 90, 0)) | div.servico-card.highlight-card → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(244, 251, 255)) | div#bannerPintura.banner-pintura → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(10, 14, 26) 0%, rgb(26, 31, 53) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 11 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 42 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn-nav → rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.3) 0px 4px 16px 0px | a.btn-primary → rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.35) 0px 8px 24px 0px | div.numero-card.fade-up → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) 0px 4px 24px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 16 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav#navbar.navbar 1440px | div.yc3-info 268px | div.yc3-info 268px | div.yc3-info 268px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 29 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 4 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (10, 5 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: Lucida Console
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14.4px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: 1 clip(s) without a poster.
findings.fix: Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: 20 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 53px from the left edge but only to 154px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: A 404px stretch at 4040px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#agendar.agendar.section-pad at 8938px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Números que comprovam nossa excelência" (screen 2, 50% hidden); "Serviços Completos em Climatização" (screen 3, 50% hidden); "Mais do que um serviço — uma parceria de confian" (screen 7, 63% hidden); "Pronto para um ambiente mais confortável?" (screen 10, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Especialistas em Instalação e Manutenção de Ar C" → 3 lines (10 words, 42.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 883px of nothing between: "Canal Renostter"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 2 sections carry text but no heading: section#diferenciais.diferenciais.section-pad at 7527px (133 words); section#mapa.mapa-atendimento.section-pad at 9314px (94 words)
findings.fix: Give each section a short heading that names what it holds (the menu, the rooms, how it works, the price), in the heading face at the section size.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Especialistas em Instalação e Manutenção de Ar C" → 4 lines (10 words, 32px); "Números que comprovam nossa excelência" → 3 lines (5 words, 28.8px); "Mais do que um serviço — uma parceria de confian" → 4 lines (10 words, 28.8px); "Onde você está? Provavelmente atendemos! 📍" → 3 lines (6 words, 25.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The margins differ: 24px on the left, 12px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1276px at 12824px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 3 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "📍 Renostter" (3px from the right); "© OpenStreetMap · © CartoDB" (9px from the right); "Renostter Climatização. Todos " (7px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 17 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "arraste para girar · role para aproximar", "Simulador de Cores", "Gire o equipamento e toque numa cor para", "Branco Pérola"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
